subject: Simple condition-name condition (conditional variable)
notes: Format: 'condition-name-1' (cite.py --check 8.8.4.5.2 "condition-name-1" -> OK §8.8.4.5.2 General format). A bare level-88 name binds as BoundCondition88 and renders through ConditionRenderer.RenderCondition88 in every condition context. Probed: bare, NOT-prefixed, subscripted (TE-ODD (1..3) -> T F T), and qualified (R-ONE OF R1V OF R1 -> T; R-ONE OF R2 -> F with a same-named 88 elsewhere) all compile and answer per the spec under --std 2023 and --std 85. l1_perform_until_condition_forms (d) derives the PERFORM UNTIL ST-DONE pass count from §8.8.4.5. [editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (§8.8.4.5 carries no edition marking; the simple condition-name condition is base COBOL in every edition)]
